# Fast Final Expense Insurance

> Fast Final Expense Insurance is an online platform for comparing and
> applying for final expense (burial) insurance. Visitors can get a quote,
> compare available coverage options, and complete an application online.
> Coverage is issued by third-party insurance carriers; coverage availability,
> pricing, and approval depend on the applicant's eligibility and the
> issuing carrier's underwriting.

## What this site is for

- Primary topic: final expense insurance (also called burial insurance or
  funeral insurance) — a smaller, permanent life insurance policy intended
  to help cover funeral, burial, cremation, and related end-of-life costs.
- Primary service: helping visitors get a final expense insurance quote,
  compare coverage options, and apply online.
- Related topics covered on this site: burial insurance, senior life
  insurance, guaranteed issue life insurance, and simplified issue /
  no-medical-exam life insurance.
- This site is a marketing and quote-comparison platform, not an insurance
  carrier. It does not guarantee approval, coverage, or pricing for any
  applicant.

## General factual information

- Final expense insurance is typically permanent (whole) life insurance
  with a smaller coverage amount than traditional life insurance, often in
  the range of $5,000–$25,000, though exact amounts vary by carrier.
- Common application types are "simplified issue" (a short list of health
  questions, no medical exam) and "guaranteed issue" (no health questions,
  often with a graded death benefit for the first two to three years).
- Coverage availability, exact pricing, and approval depend on the
  applicant's age, health, tobacco use, coverage amount selected, and the
  issuing carrier's underwriting guidelines.
- This site does not publish customer reviews, testimonials, or aggregate
  ratings.
